module parity_8bit (
    input [7:0] in,
    output out
);

assign out = in[0] ? (~in[1]) : in[1]; // Layer 1, gates 0 and 1
assign out = out ^ (in[2] ? (~in[3]) : in[3]); // Layer 2, gate 2
assign out = out ^ (in[4] ? (~in[5]) : in[5]); // Layer 3, gate 4
assign out = out ^ (in[6] ? (~in[7]) : in[7]); // Layer 4, gate 6
assign out = out ^ in[7]; // Final gate, gate 7

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn) begin
    if (!resetn) begin
      q <= 16'd0;
    end else begin
      if (byteena[0]) begin
        q[7:0] <= d[7:0];
      end
      if (byteena[1]) begin
        q[15:8] <= d[15:8];
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input load,
  input ena,
  input [3:0] data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
  if (areset) begin
    q <= 4'd0;
  end else if (load) begin
    q <= data;
  end else if (ena) begin
    q <= q + 1;
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input x,
  input y,
  output f,
  output g
);

  reg f, g;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn) begin
    if (!resetn) begin
      f <= 0;
      g <= 0;
    end
    else begin
      // Intermediate signals for clarity in RTL description
      wire s1 = ~x & y;        // from top left XOR-like structure
      wire s2 = x & ~y;        // from bottom left XOR-like structure
      wire s3 = s1 | s2;       // XOR function output
      wire s4 = s3 & x;        // AND with x
      wire s5 = s3 & y;        // AND with y
      wire s6 = s4 | s5;       // OR gate combining s4 and s5
      wire s7 = ~s6;           // NOR of previous stage
      wire s8 = x & s7;        // AND with x
      wire s9 = y & s7;        // AND with y
      wire s10 = s8 | s9;      // OR gate
      wire s11 = s10 & ~y;     // AND with NOT y
      wire s12 = s11 & ~x;     // AND with NOT x
      wire s13 = s12 | s4;     // OR with s4
      wire s14 = s13 & ~z;     // This seems to be an error in trace; assuming z=1 or re-evaluate
      // Since no external z input, assume constant or re-check connections
      // Alternatively, s13 might feed directly to next stage
      wire s15 = s13 & ~x;     // AND with NOT x for g
      wire s16 = s13 & y;      // AND with y for f
      
      f <= s16;
      g <= s15;
    end
  end

endmodule

module adder_8bit(
    input [7:0] a, b, 
    input cin, 
    output [7:0] sum, 
    output cout);

    // Internal signals for full adder outputs
    wire [0:7] sum_int, cout_int;
    wire [7:0] p, g; // Propagate and Generate

    // Full adder implementation using gates
    assign sum_int[0] = 
        (~a[0] & ~b[0] & cin) |
        (~a[0] & b[0] & ~cin) |
        (a[0] & ~b[0] & ~cin) |
        (a[0] & b[0] & cin);

    assign sum_int[1] = 
        (~a[1] & ~b[1] & sum_int[0]) |
        (~a[1] & b[1] & sum_int[0]) |
        (a[1] & ~b[1] & sum_int[0]) |
        (a[1] & b[1] & sum_int[0]);

    assign sum_int[2] = 
        (~a[2] & ~b[2] & sum_int[1]) |
        (~a[2] & b[2] & sum_int[1]) |
        (a[2] & ~b[2] & sum_int[1]) |
        (a[2] & b[2] & sum_int[1]);

    assign sum_int[3] = 
        (~a[3] & ~b[3] & sum_int[2]) |
        (~a[3] & b[3] & sum_int[2]) |
        (a[3] & ~b[3] & sum_int[2]) |
        (a[3] & b[3] & sum_int[2]);

    assign sum_int[4] = 
        (~a[4] & ~b[4] & sum_int[3]) |
        (~a[4] & b[4] & sum_int[3]) |
        (a[4] & ~b[4] & sum_int[3]) |
        (a[4] & b[4] & sum_int[3]);

    assign sum_int[5] = 
        (~a[5] & ~b[5] & sum_int[4]) |
        (~a[5] & b[5] & sum_int[4]) |
        (a[5] & ~b[5] & sum_int[4]) |
        (a[5] & b[5] & sum_int[4]);

    assign sum_int[6] = 
        (~a[6] & ~b[6] & sum_int[5]) |
        (~a[6] & b[6] & sum_int[5]) |
        (a[6] & ~b[6] & sum_int[5]) |
        (a[6] & b[6] & sum_int[5]);

    assign sum_int[7] = 
        (~a[7] & ~b[7] & sum_int[6]) |
        (~a[7] & b[7] & sum_int[6]) |
        (a[7] & ~b[7] & sum_int[6]) |
        (a[7] & b[7] & sum_int[6]);

    assign cout_int = 
        (a[7] & b[7]) | 
        (a[7] & sum_int[6]) | 
        (b[7] & sum_int[6]) | 
        (sum_int[6] & a[7] & b[7]) | 
        (a[7] & b[7] & sum_int[6]) | 
        (a[7] & sum_int[6] & b[7]) | 
        (sum_int[6] & a[7] & b[7]) | 
        (a[7] & b[7] & sum_int[6]) | 
        (a[7] & b[7] & sum_int[6]);

    assign sum = sum_int;
    assign cout = cout_int;

endmodule

module synchronizer(
	input 				clk_a	, 
	input 				clk_b	,   
	input 				arstn	,
	input				brstn   ,
	input		[3:0]	data_in	,
	input               data_en ,

	output reg  [3:0] 	dataout
);

reg [3:0] data_stable;

always @(posedge clk_b or negedge arstn) begin
	if (!arstn) begin
		data_stable <= 4'b0000;
	end
	else begin
		if (!data_en) data_stable <= 1;
		else data_stable <= {data_in, 2'd0};
	end
end

always @(posedge clk_a or negedge brstn) begin
	if (!brstn) begin
		dataout <= 4'b0000;
	end
	else begin
		dataout <= data_stable;
	end
end

endmodule
